source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Botan moz.yaml keeps the local build-glue files and skips update-moz-build. README tells the maintainer to review the vendor changes and update moz.build manually when upstream changes require it. The update action replaces the README tag from the YAML revision. This is the local dependency workflow, not proof that vendoring, build compatibility or cryptographic tests passed. The initial metadata still names2.18.2; later imports and accepted3.11.1 revision are separate phases, and current release remains3.8.1. Missing primary human context keeps full-audit credit at zero.
title: Botan vendoring preserves local build glue and leaves moz.build updates manual
